verdicts.reason: A is basically the skyscraper column dropped into a square. The subhead is squeezed into four lines that end on an orphaned "hour.", with bubbles behind the text, and the product is small, leaving large empty areas on both sides. B fixes the line breaks and enlarges the product, but its logo is shrunk until the SOLSTICE wordmark is illegible and sits off-axis at top right, aligned to nothing. B's headline is also too small for the canvas, so the hierarchy is weak. B is slightly better as a resize.
